The Powerball Jackpot is an exciting draw game that has been thrilling players for years! It began in 1992 and has since become one of the most popular lottery games in the world! The highest jackpot ever won was a whopping $1.586 billion in January 2016.

November 2022 will go down in history as the month that saw the largest lottery jackpot total ever won in the United States. The Powerball jackpot, which stood at a staggering $2.04 billion, shattered the record for the biggest single-game prize ever!

Powerball holds the record for the largest lottery prize ever awarded in the United States and is offered in 44 states, Washington DC, Puerto Rico and the U.S. Virgin Islands. The game also offers several secondary prizes, including a $1 million prize for matching five white balls and a $2 million prize for matching five white balls and the Powerball.

The Powerball jackpot is a highly sought-after prize, often reaching in excess of $300 million. The time it takes to reach this number varies, depending on the number of people playing, the tickets sold, and the rate of rollovers. Generally, it will take around three months for the jackpot to reach the large numbers it often does. To increase your chances of winning, purchase your tickets early on and keep an eye on the current jackpot amount! 

How do I know if my numbers match the winning Powerball lottery results?

You can check the USA Powerball jackpot winning numbers by visiting the Results and Winning section on our website. The US Powerball is drawn every Monday, Wednesday and Saturday at 10:59 p.m. Eastern Time, which is 9:59 p.m. Central Time, and equates to  Tuesday, Thursday and Sunday at 4 a.m in the UK. 

You must match all five main numbers and the Powerball to hit the jackpot with a win. Here’s a breakdown of the Powerball prize for more information!

Frequently Asked Questions

When is the Powerball Draw in the UK?

The Powerball draw is held every Tuesday, Thursday and Sunday at 4 a.m.! Players must match all six numbers (5 numbers + PowerBall) to win the jackpot prize, which starts at $40 million and goes up each time it is not won. There are also eight additional prize levels for matching fewer numbers, with prizes ranging from $4 for matching just the Powerball number to $1 million for matching five white balls plus the Powerball number.

How do you win the Powerball jackpot?

The Powerball lottery is a game of chance; with some luck, you can walk away with a huge jackpot. To win, you'll need to purchase a ticket with six numbers on it, five being between 1-69 and one between 1-26. Once you have your ticket, you must wait for the official draw for the lotto Powerball results winning numbers and see if you’ve matched every six numbers displayed! 

What is the biggest-ever jackpot?

A jackpot of $2.04 billion was won in November 2022. It is the largest lottery jackpot total in Powerball history!

Most popular Powerball numbers?

The most popular Powerball numbers are the following: 1, 26, 18, 10, 10, 2, 12, 11, 9, 6 and 20.

Can UK citizens play Powerball?

Yes, anyone can enter the draw online and win the jackpot. Want to try your luck? Browse our Tickets section, choose your numbers, select draw entry methods and buy! Check out our Quick Pick feature that makes buying tickets a hassle-free experience. Best of luck!
